title: Implement rectangle and text layers
description: Add tools: Rectangle (R) creates div with background color/size. Text (T) creates contenteditable element with font controls. Support fill color, stroke, border radius for rectangles.

title: Setup image editor project structure
description: Create directory structure under apps/web/src/components/image-editor/, set up base components, types, and state management. Include TypeScript config, component scaffolding.

title: Implement layer transform handles
description: Selection system with transform handles (resize, rotate). Use mouse events to drag/resize/rotate selected layers. Show bounding box with handles when layer selected.

title: Implement PNG export via Puppeteer
description: Use existing /api/projects/:id/render/image endpoint to export canvas to PNG. Trigger export from UI, handle result download. Test with multiple layers.

title: Implement CanvasWorkspace DOM layer container
description: Canvas workspace component with pan/zoom controls, grid background, and absolute-positioned layer container. Layers are DOM elements (divs) with transform-based positioning.
notes: Project structure set up. See commit a98f6f6f

title: Image Editor - HTML-based DOM editor with Puppeteer export
description: Build an HTML image editor similar to Canva/Photopea using DOM elements as layers. Approach: DOM-based editing with Puppeteer for PNG/JPEG/SVG export. Max canvas size: 2048px. Features: CSS filters (blur, drop-shadow), layer groups, rich text formatting (bold/italic/alignment), custom HTML/CSS per layer. Export uses existing /api/projects/:id/render/image endpoint.

title: Implement skill marketplace and CLI commands
description:
### Summary
Build a skill marketplace where users can discover, install, and manage skills via CLI commands.

### Current State
- Skills are manually dropped into  folder
- No browser marketplace in v1 per original plan

### Desired State
-  installs skill from repository
-  shows installed skills
-  uninstalls
-  validates skill structure
- Optional: browsable UI for skill discovery (maybe v2)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ]  command works
- [ ] Skill validation on install (checks SKILL.md structure)
- [ ]  displays installed skills with metadata
- [ ]  cleanly removes skill
- [ ]  validates skill structure
- [ ] Proper error handling for invalid repos
- [ ] Documentation for skill authors

### Technical Notes
This requires extending the od CLI with new subcommands. Should handle git cloning, validation, and daemon restart/reload.

### Dependencies
- Skill validation logic (may already exist)
- Daemon hot-reload capability or restart mechanism

title: Implement npx od init command
description:
### Summary
Create a one-command initialization that scaffolds a new Polarize project with a DESIGN.md file.

### Current State
- No init command exists; users must manually set up projects

### Desired State
-  creates a new project structure
- Includes a starter DESIGN.md file (maybe from a template)
- Sets up basic project configuration
- Initializes the .od directory structure

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ]  command works
- [ ] Creates proper project directory structure
- [ ] Generates a valid DESIGN.md (with sensible defaults)
- [ ] Initializes .od directory with required subfolders
- [ ] Provides helpful next steps after init
- [ ] Works on all supported platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux)

### Technical Notes
This should integrate with the existing od CLI (apps/daemon/src/cli.ts). May need to add new command handler.

### Dependencies
- Stable project structure definition
- DESIGN.md template system

title: Create Vercel + tunnel deployment recipe
description:
### Summary
Develop a deployment recipe that enables running Polarize with a local daemon accessible via Vercel with tunneling.

### Current State
- Not implemented yet (Topology B planned)

### Desired State
- User can deploy the web layer to Vercel
- Daemon remains local but is accessible via tunnel (e.g., localhost.run, Cloudflare Tunnel)
- Configuration is straightforward with environment variables
- Documentation covers complete setup

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Vercel deployment configuration works
- [ ] Tunnel solution documented and tested
- [ ] Environment variable configuration is clear
- [ ] Security considerations addressed (tunnel authentication, CORS)
- [ ] Step-by-step guide in docs
- [ ] Tested end-to-end deployment

### Technical Notes
This requires configuring Vercel environment, setting up tunnel to local daemon, and handling CORS/authentication properly.

### Dependencies
- Stable daemon API
- Proper CORS handling in daemon

title: Implement AI-emitted tweaks panel UX
description:
### Summary
Create a dedicated UI panel that surfaces tunable parameters from the AI, allowing users to fine-tune generated designs.

### Current State
- Not implemented yet

### Desired State
- Agent identifies key parameters worth tweaking (colors, spacing, typography, etc.)
- These parameters appear in a dedicated "Tweaks" panel in the UI
- Users can adjust parameters via sliders, color pickers, etc.
- Changes are applied in real-time or with debounced updates

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Agent can identify and emit tweakable parameters
- [ ] UI panel displays these parameters with appropriate controls
- [ ] Parameter changes don't require full regeneration
- [ ] Smooth preview updates as parameters change
- [ ] Tweaks are persisted and can be reset

### Technical Notes
This is a significant UX enhancement that requires coordination between agent output parsing, UI state management, and efficient re-rendering.

### Dependencies
- Comment-mode surgical edits foundation
- Real-time preview capabilities

title: Implement comment-mode surgical edits
description:
### Summary
Implement surgical edit capability for comment mode, allowing users to select elements and make targeted edits through chat.

### Current State
- Preview element comments and chat attachments are partially implemented
- Reliable targeted patching remains in progress

### Desired State
- Users can select any element in the preview and request specific changes
- Agent can make surgical edits to just that element or component
- Edits are precise and don't affect unrelated parts of the design

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Element selection works reliably in sandboxed iframe
- [ ] Selected element context is properly passed to agent
- [ ] Agent can generate targeted patches
- [ ] Patches apply cleanly without breaking other elements
- [ ] Undo/redo support for surgical edits

### Technical Notes
This builds on the existing element comment infrastructure but requires reliable diff/patch generation and application.

### Dependencies
- Requires stable element identification system
- Needs patch generation capability in agent adapters

title: Implement multi-select
description: Shift+click to select multiple layers. Transform handles affect all selected. Group/ungroup, align distribute actions.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts
description: V: select, R: rect, O: ellipse, T: text, I: image, Ctrl+Z: undo, Ctrl+Y: redo, Delete: delete layer, Ctrl+G: group, Shift+Ctrl+G: ungroup. Display in UI help.

title: Optimize performance for 2K canvas
description: Ensure smooth interaction with up to 50 layers on 2048px canvas. Use virtualization, canvas pooling, requestAnimationFrame, layer batching. Profile and tune.

title: Support custom HTML/CSS per layer
description: Advanced panel: raw CSS editor for each layer. Allow arbitrary CSS properties. Warning: may affect export.

title: Add CSS filters
description: Support blur and drop-shadow filters per layer. PropertiesPanel UI: blur radius, shadow (x, y, blur, color).

title: Add layer locking and visibility
description: LayerPanel: visibility toggle (eye icon), lock toggle. Locked layers cannot be selected/moved. Persist in layer state.

title: Add ellipse shape tool
description: Ellipse (O) tool creates rounded div or SVG ellipse. Support fill, stroke, border radius for circular shapes.

title: Implement layer groups
description: Groups (type 'group') can contain child layers. Support nested groups. Transform group applies to all children. LayerPanel shows tree indentation.

title: Implement undo/redo history
description: History manager stack. Record actions (add, delete, modify) with inverse for undo. Bind Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y. Limit history depth (e.g., 50).

title: Add rich text formatting
description: Text layers: bold, italic, underline, alignment (left/center/right). Font family and size selector. Content editable with toolbar.

title: UI polish and final integration
description: Consistent styling, tooltips, loading states, export progress. Accessibility: keyboard navigation, ARIA labels. Test with screen readers.

title: Implement image import
description: Image (I) tool: file picker to upload image, create img layer in canvas. Support scaling, aspect ratio lock.

title: Feature: Add HTML-to-Image backend API
description: Expose a daemon API endpoint /api/projects/:id/render/image to convert HTML artifacts to PNG/JPG. This requires integrating a headless browser (e.g., Puppeteer) into the daemon or leveraging existing MCP screenshot capabilities.

title: Feature: Expose HTML-to-Image API
description: Expose a daemon API endpoint /api/projects/:id/render/image to convert HTML artifacts to PNG/JPG using headless browser capture.

title: Feature: Add HTML to Image creation feature
description: Allow users to render HTML/DOM nodes into images.
